The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $1,028,783.39 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
